Welcome to La Mensa

Good food on Ella’s busiest street

La Mensa has been cooking on Ella’s Main Street since 2018 — Sri Lankan rice and curry, kottu, devilled dishes and fried rice alongside burgers, steaks and smoothie bowls.

Open from breakfast until late, it’s an easy stop before the morning train, after a hike up Ella Rock, or for dinner under the arches when Main Street lights up.
